headline: German Industrial Output Rebounds 0.7% in September
summary: Industrial production in Germany rose by 0.7% month-on-month in September, official statistics showed.
why: Germany is Europe's largest economy, and its industrial production index is a key barometer for regional manufacturing health.

impacts.name: Germany
impacts.why: A 0.7% monthly expansion indicates unexpected resilience in German industrial output.
